concept_decisions: Retain concept elongated lobate toe and arcuate rubble relief; reject overly equal repetitive conveyor-belt ridges and excessive photoreal grain. Use three to four unequal low curved ridge zones, locally interrupted and varying in height, merging into irregular lateral rubble. Integral angular triangulated clast-like relief in one continuous closed volume with variable-sized facets, not separate intersecting boulder pile or tiles. No isolated mountain backdrop, snow or exposed ice; gray palette artistic.
